label: t30: source-attention network r1 (ckpt_best, training-key sources) with the t22 generator
claim_type: subjective forecast registered before the network's real-scorer vote is known, before the export of the effects and before generation; no official result
status: candidate M4, not authorised to submit: generation and submission need the conditions below and the owner's ok in chat
authorization: the owner asked in chat on 3/10 (about 15:50 CEST) to do what is missing for the official submission M4; this is not an ok to submit, which is asked separately with the package in hand

model.checkpoint: ckpt_best.pt of that run (lowest validation loss on kolf and jurkat)
model.what_it_is: a weighting of effects measured in public CRISPRi screens (rlab corpus), learned from control profiles only; at step 0 it is the equal weight per line group; no per-target parameters

conditions_before_generation: the kernel ends with done.json and the network's technical gate passes (PROTOCOLLO_R1, 'Cancello tecnico')
the network's registered rule is read and written in an outcome document before any export for A, B, C
the owner authorises the download of chiavi/ and of the run folder from the kernel output, in chat
the team's quota is agreed with Davide's side: 2 scored submissions a day, one in flight
if_the_network_rule_fails: the forecast and the rule below stay as written; submitting is then a measurement of the network on the leaderboard, decided by the owner with the failed vote in hand, never a claim that the network helps

effects.sources: --sources train: the training keys of split.json, the configuration the vote measured; validation and test keys are not added
effects.basal: log1p(1e4 x pooled control fraction) of raw/controls/context_{A,B,C}.h5ad on the official axis, the formula dati.py uses for every key
effects.targets: the 300 targets of raw/controls/pert_counts.csv; a target no source covers gets lfc 0 and observed False on every gene, counted in export_abc.json
effects.amplitude: the network's own: norm-match over the covered targets of each context times the learned factor; no extra scale

generator.settings: the defaults of t22, as t29 (effects_scale 1.0, gene_dispersion false, seed 20260912, 300 targets x 400 cells per context)
generator.smoke_test: stage 45 ran on this PC on 3/10 at 15:52 CEST with zero effects, context A, 6 targets: provenance OK, projected full run 4.20 GiB, about 11 minutes

against_t22: not a single factor: the sources (rlab corpus instead of the four genome-scale sources), the effect estimator (pooled-fraction log ratio with z-shrink k 4 and gamma 1) and the weighting all change together; generator, controls, targets and packaging as t22. A score separates nothing among them; the export of net0 (step 0, equal weights) would be the control for the weighting alone

expected.calibration: Subjective planning range, not a calibrated interval. The network outputs transfer at its natural amplitude (norm-match), and unscaled transfer scored 0.060-0.071 (t08, t11) while t22 amplifies by 1.576; on the route C bench the amplitude x2 arms beat the natural ones on H1 (cross_a2 - cross +0.032 [+0.010; +0.056]). Unlike t29 the effects are measured effects of the same target in other lines, so target specificity is kept (same - same_shuf +0.128 on H1 in route C r1).
expected.members: MSE scaled expected at 0 as in every submission; PDS and the DE members below t22 if the amplitude is the main loss

rule.a_at_least_0.137: the network's effects are on a par with the reference recipe (t22/t24 mean minus the 0.005 seed noise): develop it as a candidate for D, E, F (amplitude, combination with the recipe's sources); no claim of superiority
rule.b_0.06_to_0.137: transfer-like signal at natural amplitude, not a replacement of the recipe: next an amplitude bench on public lines before any further submission of the network
rule.c_below_0.06: weaker than plain transfer: no further submission of the network until a local six-member bench shows it at least at the transfer level
rule.not: one seed and one checkpoint; the score says nothing about D, E, F and does not enter PROGETTO section 0 unless it changes the best observed

reserve: no reserve is consumed: A, B, C are the public validation contexts; the H1 2025 test split stays unopened
